title: Fixed Deep C Frame and Opposed Round Dies Planishing Hammer
description: One newly authored whole fixed floor-standing pneumatic-planishing-hammer-style exterior. A single connected thick deep C frame has a broad empty throat, opposed small round upper striking face and low crowned lower anvil, and a complete adjustable lower support shaft with collar and fixed locking lever. The upper head body sits through the forward top arm, with a whole slender stem and complete small retaining-coil appearance around its lower nose. A central stand, diagonal rear brace, low fore-aft tie and two full transverse ground feet support the whole frame. One complete low pedal housing with inset raised tread is connected by one full curved dark exterior hose to the head rear fitting; no compressor or compressed air is included. Every visible coordinate newly authored; no old cam-helve hammer, arbor press, C cutter or tool subassembly imported. Unlike the existing long pivoted timber helve and rear cam, this has no swinging arm or independent broad anvil bed. Unlike the rack-pinion arbor press, it has no rack, pinion lever, platen or worktable: the deep open C reaches two small aligned round dies and a compact head. One whole model zero scenes. All components are fixed and blunt. Empty display only: no sheet, workpiece, process, pneumatic internals, pressure, continuous air path, striking travel, vibration, tooling compatibility, thread fit, spring performance, load, engineering, manufacture or machine-safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
